name: Browserbase
short_description: Cloud browsers plus agent runs and the Stagehand framework for AI web automation.
notes: Free: 1 browser hour, 3 agent runs. Startup overage $0.10/browser hr. MCP not stated on pricing page. Open source refers to Stagehand SDK, not the hosted platform.

name: Browser Use
short_description: Open-source AI browser agent library with a pay-as-you-go cloud for agents and browsers.
notes: $5 minimum top-up; $15 free credits for eligible new signups (recorded as trial). No subscriptions; credits never expire. Proxies $5/GB residential.

name: Skyvern
short_description: Open-source LLM + vision agent that automates browser workflows like forms, logins and downloads.
notes: Pricing page mentions SDKs & API; MCP not stated. Pro add-on SMS numbers $10/mo each.

name: Hyperbrowser
short_description: Cloud browser API for AI agents, running HyperAgent, Browser Use and Claude/OpenAI computer-use agents.
notes: Main pricing page did not render; only per-credit rates from docs (1 credit = $0.001). Subscription tiers not captured, hence pricing_verified=false.

name: Steel
short_description: Open-source browser API that gives AI agents on-demand cloud browser sessions.
notes: Paid plans also bill usage on top. MCP not stated on pricing page. Infrastructure for agents rather than an end-user agent.

name: Browserless
short_description: Hosted headless browsers with REST APIs and an MCP server so AI agents can use a real browser.
notes: Paid prices shown are annual-billed monthly equivalents; monthly-billed rates not shown (annual saves 30%). 1 unit = up to 30s browser time. Open-source licence details not stated on page.

name: Anchor Browser
short_description: Cloud browsers with an embedded AI agent for automating authenticated web tasks.
notes: MCP via BrowserMCP.com. Agent task costs 0.1 credit on free plan.

name: Airtop
short_description: No-code AI browser agents that log in, navigate and automate web workflows in the cloud.
notes: Free plan includes 10,000 one-time bonus credits and 7-day trial of 'Mark'. Annual billing -10%. API/MCP not stated on pricing page.

name: Manus
short_description: General-purpose autonomous agent that browses, codes and completes multi-step tasks in a cloud computer.
notes: Pricing page and help center did not render prices; plan names from vendor docs (manus.im/docs). API docs at open.manus.ai. Capabilities from general product description; verify.

name: ChatGPT agent (incl. Atlas agent mode)
short_description: ChatGPT mode that operates a virtual browser to click, fill forms and complete tasks for the user.
notes: Prices not rendered on vendor pricing page (third-party sources cite Plus $20/mo). Agent on Plus (40 msgs/mo), Pro (400), Business/Enterprise/Edu per help.openai.com; not on Free. Atlas browser agent mode for Plus/Pro/Business. Help center says original agent now folded into main ChatGPT experience.

name: Comet
short_description: Perplexity's AI browser whose assistant can research, shop and handle web tasks on the user's behalf.
notes: Vendor page shows 'Is Comet free?' FAQ but answer not retrievable; free availability per press (CNBC Oct 2025). Paid Pro/Max/Comet Plus tiers and agent limits not verified.

name: Opera Neon
short_description: Agentic browser whose Neon Do agent reads pages, acts on commands and builds outputs from the web.
notes: Price stated on product page. No free trial mentioned; agentic features need subscription. Page mentions MCP and CLI connections.

name: Simular
short_description: Autonomous computer agent that automates desktop and web workflows via clicks and keystrokes.
notes: Access described as invite-only. API on Pro/Enterprise. Open source refers to Agent S research framework, not the commercial product. No annual pricing.

name: Amazon Nova Act
short_description: AWS service and SDK for building agents that automate browser UI workflows with natural language.
notes: Generally available. Human-in-the-loop waiting time not billed. 'Test Generation' mapped from web QA testing use case. Free tier not stated.

name: Bytebot
short_description: Open-source AI desktop agent that runs in a container and operates apps like a human.
notes: Apache 2.0; user pays own LLM API and infra costs. No hosted plan pricing shown.

name: Claude in Chrome
short_description: Chrome extension that lets Claude navigate sites, click and fill forms, including scheduled tasks.
notes: Beta; available to paid subscribers (not Free). Max listed as 'from $100/month'.

name: Axiom.ai
short_description: No-code browser automation bots with AI steps, runnable on desktop or cloud.
notes: 2 free runtime hours for new accounts, no card (recorded as trial). API and MCP server on Pro and above.

name: Bardeen
short_description: AI browser automation for scraping, web search and enrichment into Sheets, Airtable and Notion.
notes: Pricing page does not explicitly mention AI agents/API/MCP; free tier described as 'always 100 credits'. Basic and Free both list 100 credits per page.

name: Firecrawl
short_description: Web data API with an Agent endpoint that searches, navigates and extracts data for AI apps.
notes: Prices are annual-billed monthly equivalents; monthly-billed rates not captured. Agent endpoint in preview with 5 free daily runs, dynamic pricing. MCP not stated on pricing page.

name: Kernel
short_description: Autoscaling cloud browser infrastructure with stealth and managed auth for AI agents.
notes: Infrastructure for agents. Page mentions open-source projects but no specific repo verified.

name: Zapier Agents
short_description: AI agents that act across 8,000+ apps on Zapier's automation platform.
notes: Agents Pro $33.33/mo is annual-billed ($400/yr); monthly rate not captured. 14-day Professional trial. MCP: one tool call = 2 tasks. Capabilities beyond orchestration inferred from integrations; verify.

name: n8n
short_description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with AI agent nodes, self-hostable or cloud.
notes: Source-available (Sustainable Use License) rather than OSI open source. Cloud trial without card. 'Code Generation' via custom code steps + AI assistant - weak mapping.

name: Lindy
short_description: AI assistant agents that handle email, meetings, scheduling and computer-use tasks for teams.
notes: 7-day trial only for members joining via Slack; direct signups billed immediately. 1,000+ integrations.

name: Relevance AI
short_description: Platform to build an 'AI workforce' of specialist agents for sales, support, marketing and HR.
notes: Pricing page shows only Enterprise (talk to sales); self-serve tiers not shown. API and MCP referenced in site footer/docs.

name: Gumloop
short_description: No-code platform for building AI agents and workflows that automate business tasks.
notes: 14-day free trial; 8% orchestration fee on Pro; MCP server hosting included. Free plan not shown. Capabilities beyond orchestration inferred; verify.

name: Make AI Agents
short_description: Visual automation platform with AI agents that act inside Make scenarios.

name: Ribbon
